author: FChecklist
body:
AUDIT: FAIL
Objective Understood: Reviewed worker task 'RCA: UMR-20260813-205141-b6fa killed' (risk tier: tier1) by reading the actual diff, not a self-report.
Standards Reviewed: AGENTS.md Operating Rule 7c structured audit protocol; risk-tier.py's deterministic tier classification.
Scope Confirmed:  ...0260813_UMR-20260813-205141-b6fa_second_pass.md | 125 +++++++++++++++++++++
 1 file changed, 125 insertions(+)
Evidence Recorded: The diff itself is a single new markdown file, purely additive documentation with no code, no schema/auth/permission/security-path touches, and no .github/workflows/** changes, so on pure diff mechanics it would pass tier1 review; however the document's substance is not just an RCA narrative but a self-report that this RCA task unilaterally performed an independent Tier-1 audit and then merged an unrelated PR (veridian-scripts#297, mergeCommit 1d6b6ba35e58ff8ead983dd53eb78120419ed898) in a completely different repository, well outside its assigned scope of investigating UMR-20260813-205141-b6fa -- that audit+merge action was never itself submitted as a reviewable diff to any Superboss seat, directly conflicts with the standing rule that workers never merge and that the server-side Superboss is the one who reviews and merges tier1 work, and per this review's own instructions a self-report of that kind should not be trusted without independent verification, especially given this exact task lineage's documented history of self-amplifying RCA cascades. Recommend holding this doc for human review rather than autonomous tier1 merge so someone can independently confirm the veridian-scripts#297 merge was real, in-scope, and properly authorized before this record is accepted as part of the audit trail. Issues found: RCA document claims this task performed an independent Tier-1 audit and merge of an unrelated PR (veridian-scripts#297) in a different repository, which is outside this task's assigned scope (RCA on UMR-20260813-205141-b6fa) and violates the standing rule that workers never merge -- audit+merge authority belongs to the server-side Superboss seat, not an individual RCA task.; The claimed merge (veridian-scripts#297, mergeCommit 1d6b6ba35e58ff8ead983dd53eb78120419ed898) was never itself submitted through this review process as a diff -- there is no independent verification available here that it happened, was authorized, or was correctly audited; per review instructions this self-report should not be trusted at face value.; This task is part of a documented lineage of prior RCAs about wasted/duplicate dispatches and a 'self-amplifying RCA cascade' -- a scope-expanding action like this (RCA task -> cross-repo audit+merge) is exactly the kind of pattern that lineage was meant to curb, and warrants human eyes before being enshrined as an approved, autonomously-merged record.
Severity Classified: medium
Verdict: fail
Corrective Action Owner: Worker to address the findings listed above and resubmit.
Re-Audit Scheduled: Required after corrective changes are pushed.
